title: Entra preview: guest lifecycle policies that disable or delete stale external accounts
summary: Guest lifecycle policies in Microsoft Entra ID Governance Lifecycle Workflows are in public preview and let you enforce sponsor attestation, recent activity, access-package assignment, a minimum sponsor count and invitation redemption at tenant scale. A policy can disable guests, delete them, or disable them and then delete them after a grace period, with notifications to sponsors and guests before and when enforcement runs. The preview is available in the public cloud, needs an Entra ID Governance licence plus a connected Azure subscription for the guest add-on meter, and is not recommended for production workloads.
why: Stale B2B guests remain a common path into Teams, SharePoint and line-of-business apps long after the project that invited them has ended. Policy-based cleanup scales better than one-off access reviews once guest counts are large, but the preview billing and enforcement model needs a careful pilot.
todo: Confirm the tenant has Microsoft Entra ID Governance and a connected Azure subscription for the guest monthly-active-user meter before you enable a policy.
Open ID Governance > Lifecycle Workflows > Lifecycle Policies > Guest Lifecycle Policies and create a policy as a Lifecycle Workflows Administrator.
Start with a limited scope (supported attributes or direct group membership). Nested groups are not evaluated, and `userType` must be Guest regardless of how the account was invited.

Configure only the rules you intend to enforce: sponsor attestation (default 90 days, range 30–365), activity (default 90 days, range 30–730), access-package assignment expiration, minimum sponsors (default 1, range 1–5) and guest redemption for invitations still in PendingAcceptance (default 30 days, range 1–30).

Prefer Disable, then delete (grace period 7–90 days, default 30) so you have a recovery window, and keep a pre-action grace of at least one day (default seven) so sponsors see the notification before access is removed.

Make sure in-scope guests have sponsors with a usable mail attribute. A guest is assigned to only one policy at a time (highest precedence wins). A tenant can have up to 20 guest lifecycle policies, and enabled policies are evaluated once per day.
Pilot, then review compliance state and processing errors before broadening the scope. This is preview: no production SLA.
effective_note: Public preview in the public cloud as documented on 8 November 2026. No single general-availability date.
